page.overview:
What is Elizabeth?

Elizabeth, also known as One, is one of the main antagonists and twist deuteragonists in Bobbiedots, Part 1 and Bobbiedots, Part 2 in the fourth and fifth books from the Tales from the Pizzaplex series. She is one of the first-generation, also known as gen1, Bobbiedots.

One looks similar to Gemini, with her blue coloring, but damaged and scorched. She is missing an arm and the lower part of her face covering, exposing a blackened-metal, tooth-filled mouth and jaw with scorched, barren metal teeth. One’s remaining arm is missing its white exoskeleton below the forearm, so her remaining hand is nothing but battered, inky metal. Her rubbery black cables emanate from the crown of her head, similar to a topknot ponytail. Both of One’s eyes shine blue, and she has a glowing blue oval on her forehead, just like the gen2 Bobbiedots. Her voice box is damaged.

At the end of the story, Abe manages to find Elizabeth a new arm from the sewers.

While most of One's personality is unknown, she is designed to be protective of the apartment's tenant and of the Fazplex Tower, with the latter overriding the former. When Landon planned to burn down the building, she was forced to turn hostile and kill him.
